description: Zotero connector (read-only). Surfaces the user's bibliographic references from a Zotero library (`users/<id>` or `groups/<id>`) as `zotero:reference` items in the local index — the title, the formatted creator/author list, the publication date, the item type (journalArticle / book / conferencePaper / …), tags, collections, DOI, source URL, and a truncated abstract. Useful for answering research questions ("what did I save about retrieval-augmented generation?", "find my reference with DOI 10.1145/…") without leaving Nimbus. Two-identifier auth (mirrors the Stack Overflow shape): `Zotero-API-Key: <key>` header (the secret) plus a non-secret `zotero.library` spec selecting the library path. The SaaS host (api.zotero.org) is fixed; Zotero-API-Version is pinned to 3. The Zotero Web API v3 `/<library>/items` endpoint paginates by `start`/`limit` (limit max 100, `sort=dateModified&direction=desc`); the connector walks a single forward pass per cycle, page-capped. Attachments and standalone notes are skipped — v1 indexes top-level bibliographic references only.
author: Nimbus
